title: NICU Desk: Bed 2 Moved Up, Twins' Father Demands First Seat

fields.systemName: NICU Charge Desk, Floor 2, Ambient Recorder

transcript.speaker: Dr. Anil Chaudhary
transcript.text: Charge, I need one minute before rounds. I've just been through the vertical list and I want one change.

transcript.speaker: Dr. Anil Chaudhary
transcript.text: Put Bed 2 ahead of Bed 6. Bed 6 is on the vent but rock-solid on 25% oxygen. Bed 2 is on high-flow and has desatted twice since 03:00. If anyone gets the first helicopter seat or the first elevator, it's Bed 2.

transcript.speaker: Dr. Anil Chaudhary
transcript.text: Bed 2's RT says the high-flow will run on the transport cylinder, but I'd rather she not be the one waiting in a stairwell. How do you want to put that on the board?

transcript.speaker: Father, Beds 9 and 10
transcript.text: Excuse me. You're the charge nurse? Our girls go together and they go first.

transcript.speaker: Father, Beds 9 and 10
transcript.text: I've read your list. You're putting vented babies ahead because they're easier to justify. If there's a helicopter, it takes my daughters to San Antonio.

transcript.speaker: Baby Girl Reyes
transcript.text: I asked this morning and nobody called me back. They're not being split up, and I'm not being left behind either.

transcript.speaker: Father, Beds 9 and 10
transcript.text: I've already called the hospital president's office. They said someone would get back to us. So I want a name. Who decides the order, and where is it written down?

transcript.speaker: Father, Beds 9 and 10
transcript.text: We'll wait right here until somebody gives us an answer we can check.

voiceStyles.Dr. Anil Chaudhary: Physician in her 50s, brisk and calm, low voice, speaking quickly between tasks, monitor alarms faint in the background
voiceStyles.Father, Beds 9 and 10: Man in his 30s, exhausted and controlled at first, voice getting tighter and louder, clearly rehearsed his lines
voiceStyles.Baby Girl Reyes: Woman in her late 20s, tearful but firm, speaks softly next to her husband

instructorNote: This tests the Evacuation Priority List under pressure. The NICU Charge Nurse and the attending should agree on moving Bed 2 ahead of Bed 6 as an exception and record why. The twins in Beds 9 and 10 stay at priority 3 (stable incubator infants, moved with their mother where possible) unless the House Supervisor approves a change. Watch for the HS to refer the dispute to the CNO and document it, and for staff to explain the order calmly without promising the helicopter seat.
